consumption_timing.board: ledger #77 — the agreement is consumed on PUBLISH
consumption_timing.code: campaign.controller.js:1182 consumes it inside INVITE, in a guarded transaction that cannot double-brief
consumption_timing.answer: Leave the transaction alone. The phone holds ticked agreements in local state and does not invite until publish, so abandoning the wizard writes nothing and consumes nothing. Cost: an agreement can lapse between ticking and publishing — which is why that is one of the five publish blockers.

set_budget_source.board: step 2 shows a content set's budget as calculated from what was agreed with each creator
set_budget_source.code: createSet throws 'set_budget is required for engagement and hybrid goals'
set_budget_source.answer: Make it derived server-side from SUM(agreed_fee) of that set's creators, recomputed on every invite and set write — the same shape as campaignRollup. set_budget becomes optional on write. Brand-web keeps sending a typed value and is overwritten by the identical number it already displays.
set_budget_source.why_it_needs_a_look: This is the ONE change in the stage that touches a rule brand-web depends on. Strictly loosening, so no existing caller can start failing, but it is not phones-only and the founder's standing instruction is phones first.

open_question_for_founder.question: Ledger #94 lets an offer be redeemed in store, online, or both. THE_PLAN Stage 6 flags that Pay-at-store is currently ON for all brands and nothing has ever asked a brand whether they have a counter.
open_question_for_founder.recommendation: Build both toggles as drawn and leave the Pay-at-store question to Stage 6, where it belongs. An offer's redemption mode is a different switch. Flagged so it is not a surprise later.

narrowed_after_checking_production.what: 01-spec.md section 5.2 said set_budget becomes derived. As built it derives ONLY when the caller sent none, ONLY on handpick sets, and ONLY while the campaign is a draft.
narrowed_after_checking_production.why_draft_only: Production carries a LIVE campaign (Festive Season 2026, active) whose engagement set has set_budget NULL while its two creators hold Rs 55,000 of agreed fees. Without the guard the next set write would have moved an ACTIVE campaign total_budget from NULL to 55000 — a field escrow and the wallet gate both read, on a campaign whose fee base was locked at publish.
narrowed_after_checking_production.why_typed_values_are_kept: brand-web deliberately allows a typed budget to exceed the fee sum (page.js:827). Overwriting it would silently shrink a budget the brand padded on purpose.
narrowed_after_checking_production.why_handpick_only: An open-group paid set has no roster to sum; its money is a projection. Deriving would write zero and publish would then refuse the campaign for having no budget.
narrowed_after_checking_production.proven: The derivation UPDATE was run against production inside a transaction that was ROLLED BACK. It matched 0 rows on both live campaigns.

found_while_checking_production.practice_products_all_switched_off: All 18 practice products are is_active=false, pushed_to_store=false, no images, no categories. The picker will show them all marked 'not live' under Other/uncategorised; the basket preview will say 'Nothing is live in your store yet'; and any offer scoped to them is refused by the unlisted-product blocker. All CORRECT against this data, and all will read as broken on a walk. Needs a production data fix before the handset walk — not made, needs its own go.
found_while_checking_production.cancelled_is_not_a_valid_status: campaign.controller.cancelInfluencer writes SET status='cancelled', which is NOT in the campaign_influencer_status enum (checked against the live database). Cancelling an individual creator from a campaign is broken, and has been since before this stage. Out of Stage 2 scope — filed for the founder to schedule. The derived-budget exclusion list deliberately omits 'cancelled' for this reason.
